title: dactylorhiza maculata subsp. sennia
intro: Dactylorhiza maculata subsp. sennia, commonly known as the spotted orchid or leopard spider orchid, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the orchid family. It is a perennial herb with a rich history of traditional use in various cultures, valued for its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza maculata subsp. sennia are attributed to its ability to act as a diuretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a popular treatment for conditions such as urinary tract infections and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
